disclosure.group_notes: Affidavit figures from myneta.info (ADR). Charge-level details not yet compiled for MLAs.

election.group_notes: Winner, vote share and margin are ECI-published figures tabulated on the Wikipedia constituency page (ECI's results.eci.gov.in per-AC pages are offline as of Oct 2026); cross-checked against myneta/ADR winner data. Turnout is the ECI figure tabulated on the same page.
